display.name: Stripe
display.blurb: Read and manage payments data — charges, customers, payment intents, refunds, invoices, and the account balance. Authenticated with a Stripe secret key brokered at the egress proxy; the key never reaches the agent.

cli.doc:
Use the official `stripe` CLI to read and manage Stripe data from this session — charges, customers, payment intents, refunds, invoices, and the account balance. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the real, capability-scoped Stripe secret key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request to api.stripe.com; `STRIPE_API_KEY` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT run `stripe login`, set a real key, or use `stripe listen`/webhooks (those need a live login the proxy can't broker).

The CLI maps directly onto the REST API under /v1. Read with `stripe get`, write with `stripe post`, delete with `stripe delete`:
  - Balance: `stripe get /v1/balance` (requires `balance:read`). This is also the connection probe.
  - Charges: `stripe get /v1/charges` / `stripe get /v1/charges/<id>` (requires `charges:read`); `stripe post /v1/charges -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d source=tok_visa` (requires `charges:write`).
  - Customers: `stripe get /v1/customers` / `stripe get /v1/customers/<id>` (requires `customers:read`); `stripe post /v1/customers -d email=a@b.com` and `stripe delete /v1/customers/<id>` (requires `customers:write`).
  - Payment intents: `stripe get /v1/payment_intents` (requires `payment_intents:read`); `stripe post /v1/payment_intents -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd` (requires `payment_intents:write`).
  - Refunds: `stripe get /v1/refunds` (requires `refunds:read`); `stripe post /v1/refunds -d charge=<ch_id>` (requires `refunds:write`).
  - Invoices: `stripe get /v1/invoices` (requires `invoices:read`); `stripe post /v1/invoices -d customer=<cus_id>` (requires `invoices:write`).

List params use repeated `-d`, e.g. `stripe get /v1/charges -d limit=3 -d "created[gte]=1700000000"`. A request to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated. Run `stripe --help` to explore other resources (those still flow through the brokered key but only granted paths are reachable).
